subject.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages

question: Should this Feishu newline candidate stay blocked until live Feishu/Lark proof is attached, or should maintainers provide/accept another proof path for this branch?
rationale: The code path appears clean, but the user-visible bug depends on Feishu/Lark rendering behavior that generated payload output does not fully prove, and several sibling PRs target the same bug.

options.title: Require live proof before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and safe near-limit delivery.

options.title: Maintainer supplies sandbox proof
options.body: If the contributor lacks tenant credentials, a maintainer can run the same branch in a sandbox tenant and attach redacted proof before merge.

options.title: Choose the proof-positive sibling
options.body: If maintainers prefer the screenshot-backed sibling, designate it canonical only after its conflicts are resolved, then close the remaining candidates afterward.

recommendation.title: Require live proof before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until a redacted Feishu/Lark screenshot, recording, API transcript, or log from this branch shows corrected rendering and safe near-limit delivery.
